# nvcc's own predefined macros (CUDA Toolkit), to merge over the host compiler's.
#
# Format (as the EDG C/C++ front end's predefined_macros.txt):
#   mode[,mode]   cannot_redefine   name   value
#
# Generated by tools/predefined-macros/generate.sh on 2026-11-20: the macros the
# CUDA Toolkit's nvcc adds to the host compiler's set, read by subtracting
# 'gcc -x c++ -dM -E -' from 'nvcc -E -Xcompiler -dM -x c++ unit.cu' in the CUDA image.
# Cuda compilation tools, release 12.4, V12.4.131 (nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-devel-ubuntu22.04)
#
# A unit nvcc compiles also has __CUDACC__ 1, which the CUDA Toolkit guide documents for
# CUDA source files and the -E stage alone does not print; it is written by hand.
#
all no  __CUDACC__ 1
all no  __CUDACC_VER_BUILD__ 131
all no  __CUDACC_VER_MAJOR__ 12
all no  __CUDACC_VER_MINOR__ 4
all no  __CUDA_API_VER_MAJOR__ 12
all no  __CUDA_API_VER_MINOR__ 4
all no  __NVCC_DIAG_PRAGMA_SUPPORT__ 1
all no  __NVCC__ 1
